full_judgment: 2. The petitioner along with opposite party Nos. 1-3 were contestants in the, Election of Chairman of North Bakharnagar Union Parishad which was held on 10.2.88. The petitioner polled 1764 votes, the opposite party No. 1 polled 1455 votes, the opposite party No. 2 polled 1024 voted and the opposite party No. 3 polled 943 votes. The petitioner was declared elected as the Chairman and within the period of limitation from the date of Gazette Notification, the opposite party No. 1 filed Election Tribunal Case No. 1 of 1988 against the petitioner challenging his election on the ground that the petitioner' was a dealer in essential commodities appointed by the Government and remained so till the date of filing of nomination paper on 10.1.88 and was therefore disqualified to be elected or nominated as a Chairman under section 7(i)(f) of the Union Parishads Ordinance, 1983. The petitioner contested the case by filing a written objection and stating that he had submitted his resignation as a dealer to the Upazila Food Officer by a letter dated 9.1.88 which was accepted by the said Upazila Food Officer on 10.1.88. Hence he was not disqualified.
